detail: Science raised a $400 million Series D funding round to support its neurotech development and upcoming US launch of the PRIMA implant.
why_relevant: As a leading neurotechnology startup scaling up implants, Science offers strong internship opportunities for applying biosignal-ML and neuromodulation expertise.

detail: Neuralink showcased clinical trial participants controlling advanced video games and devices using brain-computer interfaces while preparing for future trials.
why_relevant: Their cutting-edge invasive BCI work directly aligns with neuromodulation and neural decoding principles taught in BME graduate programs.

detail: SetPoint Medical's wireless vagus nerve stimulation device is now commercially available following its FDA approval for treating rheumatoid arthritis.
why_relevant: Their bioelectronic medicine approach to treating autoimmune diseases via vagus nerve neuromodulation is highly relevant for a neuromodulation student.

detail: Private equity firm KKR completed the acquisition of medical device CDMO Integer Holdings in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately $5.7 billion.
why_relevant: Integer is a major player in manufacturing neuromodulation and cardiac rhythm management hardware, offering broad exposure to medical device engineering.

detail: Theraclion received FDA De Novo authorization for its noninvasive ultrasound treatment system for varicose veins.
why_relevant: Their noninvasive focused ultrasound technology parallels advanced therapeutic neuromodulation and ultrasound-based brain stimulation techniques.
